candidate.answerReason: The graph shows that Carmen travels 35 miles in 7 hours. Her average speed is total distance divided by total time: 35 ÷ 7 = 5 miles per hour.

methods.label: Use the totals for the ride
methods.explanation:
Average speed is the constant speed that would cover the same total distance in the same total time. Thus we need the totals for the entire ride.

The graph starts at \(0\) miles and \(0\) hours and ends at \(35\) miles and \(7\) hours. Since distance equals speed times time, divide the total distance by the total time:
\[
\text{average speed}=\frac{35\text{ miles}}{7\text{ hours}}
=\boxed{5\text{ miles per hour}}.
\]
The answer is choice \(\boxed{\text{E}}\).
